historyTimeline.h2: Range Rover Evoque Si4 - Engine History & Specs at a Glance
historyTimeline.intro: When the Si4 variant was introduced to the Range Rover Evoque lineup, it brought refined 2.0-litre turbocharged petrol performance to the compact luxury SUV, offering a smoother, more responsive alternative to the diesel variants while maintaining the Evoque's signature style and capability.

milestones.description: PT204 (2.0L Turbo Petrol), 237hp, introduced as the performance petrol option for the first-generation L538 Evoque, featuring Ford-sourced EcoBoost architecture with direct injection.
PT204 (2.0L Turbo Petrol), 250hp, continued in the second-generation L551 Evoque with refined Ingenium branding and improved efficiency, though affected by cooling system fire risk recall.

historyTimeline.closingNote: Every engine fitted to the Range Rover Evoque Si4 is covered below, with UK rebuilt pricing and known failure points.

commonProblems.h2: Range Rover Evoque Si4 Engine Problems - Repair Cost vs Replacement
commonProblems.h3: The Range Rover Evoque Si4 (PT204) is generally more reliable than its diesel Ingenium counterparts, but it carries specific failure modes that owners must be aware of. The most critical issue is the cooling system fire risk recall affecting 2017-2023 models. Rebuilt engines sourced through EnginesMarket include upgraded cooling components addressing these original failure points, backed by a minimum 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

problems.h4: Cooling System Fire Risk - Why the Range Rover Evoque Si4 PT204 (2017-2023) Requires Immediate Attention
problems.affectedModels: Range Rover Evoque Si4 (PT204, 2017-2023, all second-generation L551 models)
problems.typicalFailureMileage: Unpredictable - recall affects all 2017-2023 production regardless of mileage
problems.rootCause: Coolant system component failure causes rapid overheating and pressurisation, leading to coolant ejection and engine fire risk. JLR issued a formal recall after multiple documented fires.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace coolant pump, expansion tank, hoses, and update ECU software with revised calibration.
repairOptions.longevity: Prevents the fire risk entirely. One-time preventative cost for 2017-2023 models.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Cylinder head skim, gasket replacement, cooling system overhaul, oil and coolant flush.
repairOptions.longevity: 40,000-60,000 mile lifespan after repair. Risk of hidden damage remains.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit reconditioned short or long engine with upgraded cooling components.
repairOptions.longevity: Only option after catastrophic overheating or fire. Ensure recall completed on replacement.

problems.recommendation: For 2017-2023 Si4 owners, verify the cooling system recall has been completed immediately. For turbo or HPFP issues, targeted specialist repair is cost-effective if caught early. However, if the PT204 has suffered catastrophic overheating, severe internal wear, or multiple component failures, a full rebuilt engine with upgraded cooling and fuel system components offers the best long-term reliability and protects your investment.

problems.group: Turbocharger Bearing Failure & High-Pressure Fuel Pump Issues
problems.h4: Turbocharger Bearing Failure & High-Pressure Fuel Pump Issues - Why the Range Rover Evoque Si4 PT204 Loses Performance
problems.affectedModels: Range Rover Evoque Si4 (PT204, 2011-2024, all generations)
problems.rootCause: Turbocharger bearing wear leads to oil consumption and boost loss, while high-pressure fuel pump (HPFP) failure causes hard starting, misfires, and potential fuel system contamination.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace turbocharger unit, flush oil system, inspect for metal debris.
repairOptions.longevity: Viable if caught before metal reaches cylinders.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace HPFP, fuel filter, perform fuel system flush, reset adaptation values.
repairOptions.longevity: Suitable if caught immediately after first starting issues.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit rebuilt unit with upgraded turbo and fuel system components, 12-month warranty.
repairOptions.longevity: Best value for high-mileage engines with multiple failures.
